phiCloudFallback.description: Must stay false. AirlockMD refuses to send identifiers to the cloud even if this is flipped.

injectionPolicy.description: block requires a person to strip hidden instructions before release. redact_and_warn strips them and warns.

scanStrictness.description: high also holds SUSPICIOUS documents for review. standard holds only INJECTION_DETECTED.

policyVersion.description: Label stored on the audit ledger and stamped into the tokenized payload.
